remarks: Prime location for easy access to city life and public transportation, this desirable townhouse has a combination of convenience and comfort. With over 1,400 square feet of living space, it is one of the few units in the complex with 3 bedrooms. Additional features include 2.5 baths, central air conditioning, a washer and dryer conveniently located on the main level, a carport and an additional outdoor parking space. The spacious living room features hardwood floors, a fireplace, and sliding doors leading to a private balcony. The updated kitchen features quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and modern cabinetry. All three bedrooms are located on the upper level, including the primary suite, which features a vaulted ceiling with a skylight, a double closet, and an ensuite bath complete with a jacuzzi tub. Hardwood floors run throughout the main level and upper level, while a pull-down attic staircase provides additional storage space. The unit also includes a private storage room off the carport and ample guest parking.
